enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.

Spell Resonance: This item hums ominously with suppressed energy. When casting Force spells, there is a chance that you will gain a +20 alchemical bonus to Force Spell Power for 30 seconds. When casting Sonic spells, there is a chance that you will gain a +20 alchemical bonus to Sonic Spell Power 30 seconds.
Soundproof: Protects against stunning, dazing and disorientation from sound-based spells such as Soundburst and Greater Shout.
Resonance +111: Passive: +111 Equipment bonus to Sonic Spell Power.
Impulse +111: Passive: +111 Equipment bonus to Force, Untyped, Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning Spell Power.
Sonic Resistance +36: Passive: +36 Enhancement bonus to your Sonic Resistance.
